question: What claim about success in this practice is at stake in making it conditional on knowing the eight-times-eight method?
premises: The eight-times-eight method is a defined procedure.
Knowing that method is the stated condition.
Success does not occur by any other means.
inference: Success is strictly conditional on knowing the eight-times-eight method and not otherwise.
uncertainties: The nature of the success intended is not specified within this verse alone.
plain_english: Having known the eight-times-eight method, one succeeds; not otherwise.
